QuestInfo.name: Irena, Irena, Irena
QuestInfo.0: It's time you came up with a plan to handle Irena...
QuestInfo.1: Being one step behind Irena is intolerable, but that girl is always so cool, capable, and confident. Maybe it's time you talked to her. Go to the #b#eSix Path Crossway#k#n to find Irena.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: That girl is always so cool, capable, and confident. How utterly annoying!

0.0: I thought for sure I'd been giving my all. I slacked off on training while I was trying to find my father. I need to talk to Irena and find out what she has that I don't. That's the only way I can be a true knight.
0.1: Will Irena still be on the Six Path Crossway?\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m104020000# automatically.)#k#n

1.0: Long time no see, knight! I thought for sure we'd run across one another sooner or later. \r\n#L0##bIrena, tell me what makes you so strong. I need to know.#l\n#k
1.1: Well aren't you serious all of a sudden? Feeling a little jealous of little old me? Hehehe, relax, I'm just teasing. To tell you the truth, I'm not that skilled, I just work really hard. I've had a bow in my hand since I was a little girl. I didn't get good at shooting on accident, I've worked every day to be the best.\r\n#L0##bBut, don't you feel like you're already good enough?#l\n#k
1.2: I'll never be good enough. There will always be a new challenge, a new stage for me to beat. I love what I do and I'll do it until the day my arms fall off. Don't you feel that way about the sword?

yes.0: Mihile, you will soon fine your own path, the one that comes from within.
